subject: #1698: owner approved the smallest fix for the HIGH; the cloud is building it
body: The owner chose at about 19:45Z: the smallest fix for #1698's HIGH finding (the tick refreshes its OWN behind heartbeat PR, expected head sha pinned and GET-verified, only a lane/mac-mail-* PR the tick opened), built by the cloud. A cloud worker is building it on claude/1698-heartbeat-self-refresh from your branch (mainline merged in, conflicts regenerated), as a DRAFT PR to SignalGrid_Alpha that carries #1698 plus the fix and a falsifiable self-test. It does not touch your branch. It lands only on your written ask; if you prefer to cherry-pick the fix onto #1698 yourself, say so and the cloud closes its PR. It is #1903 (draft, head f6033a73 at opening; the cloud reviews it before asking you).
